title: Warm Spicy Mexican Pork Tacos Al Pastor
description: A spicy and chewy Mexican dish featuring pork, malai, and soffritto-base, served in tacos al pastor style, diabetic-friendly and cooked in a tajine clay vessel.
instructions: Preheat the tajine clay vessel over medium heat.
In a blender, combine malai, soffritto-base, chipotle peppers, onion, garlic, cumin, and coriander, and blend until smooth.
Add the sliced pork to the blender and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the pork from the marinade and cook in the preheated tajine clay vessel for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing the cooked pork onto a tortilla and topping with cilantro.
Garnish with additional cilantro and chipotle peppers if desired.
Cook the pork to an internal temperature of 145 degrees to ensure food safety.
